scope: All 43 of the originally 66 undecided Sacred Atlas Places without a previously byte-verified original image; site evidence carried forward without new searches or requests.
policy: An indexed file/category or nearby geotag is a lead, not an exact physical-building and licence verification.
Original source metadata eligible results are not byte verification or owner choices.
If a source image is undersized, do not enlarge artificially and claim high-quality original.
Rights or freedom of panorama holds remain in place, especially Tonga's Basilica of St Anthony.
Use accessible official custodian site to identify building context, not to scrape unlicensed photos or contact rights owners.
Do not retry Commons source downloads during HTTP 429 throttling, substitute unrelated site artwork or promote any of these 43 to public app assets.
These 43 plus the existing 23 Places in the R26 source review exactly reconstruct the original 66 undecided cover Places.
